title: Existence of a nonzero geometric germ
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], N,F abelian sheaves on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and ψ:N→F a nonzero morphism. There exist a nonempty etale X-scheme U, a section s of N on U, an algebraically closed field Ω, a geometric point t:Spec Ω→X and a lift v to U such that the germ of ψ(s) at v [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is nonzero.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_section_nonzero_at_some_germ (X : Scheme.{u})
    (N F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (ψ : N ⟶ F) (hψ : ψ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (U : X.Etale) (_ : Nonempty U.left) (s : N.obj.obj (op U)),
      ∃ (Ω : Type u), ∃ (_ : Field Ω) (_ : IsAlgClosed Ω)
        (t : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X) (v : (pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj U),
        (pointSmallEtale t).toPresheafFiber U v F.obj
          (ψ.hom.app (op U) s) ≠ 0
